name: Norboo Spon Guesthouse Restaurant
why_it_matters: One of Likir's longest-running guesthouses — the family also hosts SimPL Ladakh permaculture courses, and the kitchen draws from their own organic plot. Vegetarian buffet, no menu, whatever the cook has prepared that day. Trekkers heading out on the Likir-Tingmosgang route fuel up here.
insider_tip: Walk-in lunch isn't guaranteed — call ahead the same morning so they cook for an extra plate. Sits just outside the main village near where the road branches to Hemis Shukpachan; ten minutes' walk from the monastery.
signature_address: Likir Village, near Hemis Shukpachan road junction, Likir 194107, Leh District, Ladakh

name: Old Likir Traditional Farm Stay Kitchen
must_try: scrambled eggs with tomato and herbs
why_it_matters: Stanzin and Tsomo's farmstay sits just below Likir Monastery on the old highway; the property previously listed as 'Old Likir Guest House & Restaurant.' Tsomo cooks the meals — ingredients pulled from the family's own fields, recipes are the household's, and travel writers consistently single out the food over the rooms.
insider_tip: Lunch is on request only and the kitchen is small — call when you arrive in the village rather than dropping in. Order whatever Tsomo is cooking that day; the eggs-with-tomato-and-herbs breakfast is the dish reviewers keep coming back to.
signature_address: National Highway 1, below Likir Monastery, Likir 194101, Leh District, Ladakh
